description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library. This fighter runs a Whisper-small fine-tune for Sesotho, from the misterkissi community exports and the plugin's built-in default for 'st'.
notes: Plugin-default model for lang 'st' per defaults.py LANG_DEFAULTS; verified present on HuggingFace via HfApi.
